# Card

A bordered container for one item or group, with its title, content and actions.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Brand expressive</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Brand expressive:** Products and features.

- **Use it when:** A repeating unit of title, media and one destination or action.
- **Not when:** Records people compare cell by cell (a table), or a whole card as one big link that screen readers read as one.

Instead:

- [Table](./table.md): Records compared across rows.
- Item: A compact row in a list.

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] One inner link or button names the destination; the rest is not one big link. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add card
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Component keys

The CSS variable is the key with `/` replaced by `-` and the base `@` dropped. Each key points to a token; values live only on primitives.

| Key | What it controls | Points to, light | Points to, dark |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `card/background` | Card fill. | `color.surface.default` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.surface.default` → `color.taupe.light.0` | `color.surface.default` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.surface.default` → `color.taupe.dark.50` |
| `card/border` | Card border. | `color.border.default` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.border.default` → `color.taupe.light.200` | `color.border.default` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.border.default` → `color.taupe.dark.100` |
| `card/radius` | Card corner radius. | `radius.container` → `brand-expressive.theme.base.radius.container` → `radius.24` | same |
| `card/padding` | Padding inside a card. | `space.inset.container` → `space.32` | same |
| `card/shadow` | Card shadow. | `elevation.card` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.elevation.card` → `shadow.card` | `elevation.card` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.elevation.card` → `shadow.card-dark` |
